FXStandingInstruction.name: FX Standing Instruction
FXStandingInstruction.definition: Specifies whether the forex standing instruction in place should apply.

SettlementStandingInstructionDatabase.name: Settlement Standing Instruction Database
SettlementStandingInstructionDatabase.definition: Specifies what settlement standing instruction database is to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in the transaction.

SSIDatabaseName.name: SSI Database Name
SSIDatabaseName.definition: Specifies the settlement standing instruction database to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in a transaction.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of the payment to which the SSI applies.

Settlement.name: Settlement
Settlement.definition: Settlement process to which the settlement instruction database applies.

RelatedCollateralAgreement.name: Related Collateral Agreement
RelatedCollateralAgreement.definition: Collateral agreement for which standing settlement instructions are specified.

SSIDatabaseProvider.name: SSI Database Provider
SSIDatabaseProvider.definition: Party which provides information on the parties and accounts to be used to settle a transaction.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Period during which the SSI is valid.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Inidicates the asset for the standing settlement instruction.
